take_plan.alignment: Measured captions and the acoustic word stream decide every timing. The authored clock in narration_picture is provisional and approves no timing.

overall: One continuous read of the whole passage in one take. Read it as a person who knows this subject, explaining what a release says and what it does not show. Dry and plain. Not a news anchor, not a documentary hush, not a bright explainer lilt. Energy moves in drops as well as lifts: the opening question is brisk and curious, the mechanism steady, the limit the lowest and most certain part, and the close level and falling. Carry connected phrases across every sentence join. Give room only at the source-backed turn and at the closing line.
performance_arc: Brisk question and return, plain dated facts, an ordinary sign-in, specific source types, a measured share, then a slower plain limit and a level close.

lines.text: A UTMB clinician asks a question. The answer comes back with its sources.
lines.intent: Open on the ordinary act of asking a question inside the chart, then hand the viewer the return. Curiosity first with no alarm.
lines.energy: Opening lift, brisk and curious, the most forward energy so far, moving straight into the return without a reset.
lines.pause_after: Full stop with a small breath, then carry straight into line 2 with no reset in pitch.
lines.reason: The question card leaves the chart at s1-event-1, so the voice leans into motion. The emphasis sits on the return because the return is the answer to the viewer's question, and the sources arrive on s1-event-2 and s1-event-3.

lines.text: UTMB announced the OpenEvidence AI tool on September twenty-second, and says it went live in March.
lines.intent: State the dated announcement plainly, the way a reporter reads a release date, with the attribution to UTMB audible.
lines.emphasis: says it went live in March
lines.energy: Level and plain, one step down from the opening lift into a steady informative pace with no added excitement.
lines.pause_after: No break at the date comma, a connected run into the attribution. Normal full stop after March.
lines.reason: The boundary lights at s2-event-1 and the announcement tag attaches at s2-event-2, so the date is pictured. The March tag at s2-event-3 is a fact on screen, so the voice carries the source's own word says to mark it as UTMB's claim.

lines.text: Clinicians sign in with their usual credentials and ask in plain language.
lines.intent: Describe the ordinary sign-in as familiar and unremarkable so the viewer sees an everyday login, not a new system.
lines.energy: Conversational and unhurried, a step below the dated fact, with no lift anywhere in the line so the sign-in sounds ordinary.
lines.pause_after: Connected join into line 4, normal full stop, no held silence.
lines.reason: The lock opens at s3-event-1 on the credential, so usual credentials is the one phrase that matches what is shown. Keeping the energy flat stops a routine login from sounding like a breakthrough.

lines.text: The answers carry citations to medical literature and clinical guidelines.
lines.intent: Name the two kinds of source the answer carries so the viewer hears specific source types, not a vague word for sources.
lines.energy: Crisp and even, a clear middle level, giving each source type its own weight and easing off after clinical guidelines.
lines.pause_after: Normal full stop and a small breath, the list closes cleanly before the share.
lines.reason: The citation cards fan out at s4-event-1, and the literature and guidelines cards lift one at a time at s4-event-2 and s4-event-3. The voice gives each named source type its own beat to match each lifting card.

lines.text: UTMB says more than half of its clinicians now use it for clinical decision support.
lines.intent: Report the usage share as UTMB's own statement, flat and measured, not as a verified count and not as a triumph.
lines.energy: Level and even, a little below the source types, with no lift on more than half, so the share is stated rather than celebrated.
lines.pause_after: Connected run into the turn, no hold, the limit follows at once.
lines.reason: Figures light past the halfway tick at s5-event-2, which is the picture of the share. The attribution is the qualifier the picture does not carry on its own, so the emphasis goes on UTMB says. A flat delivery keeps the picture from reading as a measured count.

lines.text: That is UTMB's own report. The release publishes no measure of accuracy or patient care.
lines.intent: Pin the share to UTMB's own report, then state the missing measure as a plain fact the release does not contain. This is the performed turn.
lines.energy: The lowest and slowest line of the piece, certain and level, with the least pitch movement so the most important limit is the quietest delivery.
lines.pause_after: A held breath after own report, earned at the source-backed turn, then a full stop before line 7 with no change in tone.
lines.reason: The report tag pins to the share at s6-event-1, then the accuracy and patient-care tags clip onto the answer at s6-event-2 and read not in release at s6-event-3. The limit is the most important fact, so it gets the quietest, most certain delivery and the only earned breath before the close.

lines.text: A citation shows where an answer says it came from. It doesn't show the answer is right.
lines.intent: Separate the two things a citation does, locating the source and not certifying the answer, with the contrast landing on the negation.
lines.energy: Measured and firm, the first sentence plain, the second rising to doesn't and falling low and final on right, a little more forward than the line before.
lines.pause_after: One short breath after came from, the single interior breath of the line, then straight into It with no reset.
lines.reason: The citation card points back to its source type at s7-event-1, which is what the first sentence describes. The empty Accuracy slot lights at s7-event-2 and nothing lands at s7-event-3, which is the negation. The emphasis sits on doesn't so the word that matches the empty slot is the one the viewer hears.

lines.text: UTMB says it will keep evaluating use and clinician experience.
lines.intent: End on UTMB's stated next step, a plan to keep evaluating rather than an outcome, so the film closes on what is not yet known, stated flat.
lines.energy: Level and low, unhurried, a settled falling close with no upturn at the end, and the last word experience landing lowest and final.
lines.pause_after: Full stop at the close, then the take ends. No tail and no added hold.
lines.reason: The evaluation tag pins to the share at s8-event-1 and the answer holds beside the chart with its empty Accuracy ring at s8-event-3. The performed close is a plan, not a result, so keep evaluating carries the weight and nothing is lifted to suggest a finding.
